Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

steps.instruction:
交付封裝/GCD映射、分片覆蓋與可見性診斷。
在交接件中加入「Frontier MI250X：架構、所有權與資料介面」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：八份各32總256；反查若只建四份，每個GCD是否未覆蓋或工作重複；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：建立節點→封裝→GCD三層身份表，為每個工作記可見裝置ID及封裝關聯；32/64重現，八個GCD各有唯一分片，未把總HBM當單一共享空間。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver package/GCD mapping, shard coverage and visibility diagnostics.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Frontier MI250X: architecture,ownership and data interfaces: Eight shards of 32 total 256; inspect a mistaken four-shard plan for uncovered dies or duplicate work. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Build node→package→GCD identities and record visible device plus package for each job. Reproduce 32/64 with unique shards on eight GCDs and no assumption of one pooled HBM space. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。八份各32總256；反查若只建四份，每個GCD是否未覆蓋或工作重複；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Eight shards of 32 total 256; inspect a mistaken four-shard plan for uncovered dies or duplicate work. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 八份各32總256；反查若只建四份，每個GCD是否未覆蓋或工作重複；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.checkEn: Eight shards of 32 total 256; inspect a mistaken four-shard plan for uncovered dies or duplicate work. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Frontier 每節點四個MI250X封裝，各含兩個GCD；本課分清封裝、可見裝置與工作分片。
knowledge.textEn: Frontier nodes contain four MI250X packages with two GCDs each; this lesson distinguishes packages, visible devices and shards.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立節點→封裝→GCD三層身份表，為每個工作記可見裝置ID及封裝關聯；32/64重現，八個GCD各有唯一分片，未把總HBM當單一共享空間。
knowledge.textEn: Build node→package→GCD identities and record visible device plus package for each job. Reproduce 32/64 with unique shards on eight GCDs and no assumption of one pooled HBM space.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 可見GCD數D=packages×dies；等分N工作後每GCD N/D，不將封裝數當裝置數。
knowledge.textEn: Visible GCD count D=packages×dies; equal shards have N/D work, not N/packages.
